title: Detect the execution mode
summary: Route a public GitHub run to hosted Ubuntu, support a local checkout, and use an opt-in self-hosted runner for trusted private or internal GitHub pushes. BART draft #74 is the integration candidate.
acceptance_criteria: Pass the public workflow on the exact candidate SHA.

evidence.claim: Public CI passed at this draft commit. Live private runner scheduling remains pending.
